The sea ceased to roar and became calm;
The boats were not plying;
In the deep creeks; sharks were roaming;
The women of slanderous tongue were busy
Spinning canard about us;
Yet he was with us, inseparable,
Though it was bright day time.
Indeed his high and ornate chariot
Was waiting for him.
Such was our hero, the lord of littoral region.
Those were our pre-marital days
Where his chances of meeting us were rare indeed.
Those days are now gone.
Though he now behaves like a stranger
By not visiting us,
After freeing himself from the clutches of the hetairas,
Our heroine of bright forehead with tearful eyes
Says to me:
The night heron with its curved beak
